metadata.title: The Spider Stellar Engine: a Fully Steerable Extraterrestrial Design?

notes: No star meets either contribution category. The paper proposes spider pulsars as "stellar engine" technosignature candidates, but it does not identify them as Galactic unbound candidates; the escape-velocity calculation at T:p2-b17 concerns escape from the binary, not the Milky Way. The background hypervelocity-star search discussed at T:p2-b10 reports no good candidates.
